title: A guarded tracker edit that loses a race to a same-value removal is retried, not failed (quest reports it as validation, not conflict)
description: BLOCKS the paired 0.11.0 release: opum-cli-e2e suites/40-cross-product.mjs row "same-value competing removal" (TASK-90) failed 5 of 5, making quest 0.11.0 pass-1 receipt NOT QUALIFIED (opum-ai/opum-cli-e2e#299), and lore 0.11.0 own receipt will hit the same row. ROOT CAUSE, read from the harness source at opum-cli-e2e origin/dev (lines ~530-555), not guessed: with a STALE --if-revision and a removal target that is already gone, quest 0.10.0 returns exit-6 validation ("no entry matches") instead of the exit-5 conflict its own `quest help task edit` promises. It reproduces on both --remove-label and --remove-assignee. lore withConflictRetry (src/commands/link.ts ~526) retries only on error type "conflict", so the race surfaces as a hard failure instead of being absorbed. The quest-side fix (check the precondition first) belongs to quest-cli. LORE MITIGATION (this task): when a guarded edit (one that sent ifRevision) fails with a validation LoreError, re-read the task; if its revision differs from the one sent, the edit lost a race, so rethrow as a conflict so the bounded retry re-reads and re-decides (and finds the label already gone, i.e. already-absent). Otherwise rethrow the original error unchanged. The decision is by revision comparison, never by message text. Also CHECK the lore link path (src/commands/link.ts ~309): its editTask sends addLabels plus a whole-list doc with NO ifRevision, which looks like the original LCLI-522 exposure left unguarded; either guard it the same way or record why it is safe.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A test with a stub adapter that throws a validation error while the task revision has moved shows lore unlink (and every guarded edit site) retrying and ending already-absent / success; a validation error with an UNCHANGED revision is rethrown unchanged
Mutation: removing the revision comparison (never converting) turns the race test red, and always converting turns the unchanged-revision test red
The lore link edit path is either guarded with ifRevision plus the same retry, or has a recorded reason it cannot lose data; bun test and bun run lore check exit 0

implementationNotes: ROOT CAUSE CORRECTED BY MEASUREMENT (branch fix/LCLI-614-race-retry). The task diagnosis (stale --if-revision answered as validation) is real but is NOT what failed the harness row. Instrumenting guardedEditTask during a real concurrent race (lore from source vs quest 0.10.0, harness shape) showed sent revision == re-read revision, with the label already gone: lore read AFTER the competitor, saw hadLabel=false but hadDoc=true (lore link writes label AND --doc; the competitor removes only the label), and removeBackRefs still sent removeLabels:[label] unconditionally. Quest >=0.8.0 (QCLI-297) fails an absent-label removal loudly with exit-6 validation. Nothing raced, so no revision logic could have caught it. With only the conversion fix, the concurrent race still failed 10/10. Quest help task edit itself says a caller wanting remove-if-present should read first and skip. TWO FIXES, both in src/commands/link.ts: (1) removeBackRefs sends removeLabels only when its own read found the label, and sends the STORED spelling (quest matches exactly; hasLabel is case-insensitive). (2) guardedEditTask, the single helper every guarded edit site uses (unlink, rename move, and now link): sends ifRevision from the same read; on a validation LoreError it re-reads via verifiedViewTask and, only if the revision moved, rethrows a conflict (original kept as cause, quoted in message, and in input.trackerError) so withConflictRetry re-reads and re-decides. Unchanged revision, a record gone or reporting no revision, a failed re-read, a non-validation error, or an unguarded edit all rethrow the ORIGINAL error object. Decided by revision comparison only, never message text. This still matters: sequential probe on quest 0.10.0 confirms a stale --if-revision plus gone target returns exit 6, not 5.

TESTS. Stub (test/link.test.ts, describe "guarded tracker edits ... (LCLI-614)", 9 tests; fakeAdapter gains editTaskValidation {times,error,competingWrite} and strictRemovals in test/helpers.ts): unlink race -> already-absent exit 0, 1 edit carrying ifRevision r1; move race -> already-current; link race -> already-present, patch now {addLabels,doc,ifRevision:r1}; race lost every attempt -> bounded at 4 edits, drift, per-task error still quotes the tracker message; unchanged revision -> not retried, per-task error equals original message exactly; unchanged revision with an actor-context validation error -> command throws the SAME object (toBe), type validation, same message; failed re-read -> original rethrown; label-absent (doc only, strict removals) -> exit 0, patch {doc,ifRevision} with no removeLabels; case-differing stored label -> removed by stored spelling. One existing expectation updated: --allow-missing case test now expects removeLabels ["doc:stories/Foo"] (stored spelling). REAL QUEST (test/link-quest-race.test.ts, skipIf no quest on PATH; CI lint/typecheck/test job installs no quest so it runs on workstations only, stubs are the gate): (a) competitor runs deterministically between the real adapter read and the guarded edit -> real quest 0.10.0 refuses with validation, lore converts, unlink already-absent exit 0; (b) real guarded lore link, competitor removes label, then unlink -> exit 0, label gone. Both pass against installed quest 0.10.0. MUTATIONS, subsets predicted in the test block header before running, all matched exactly: never-convert -> 5 red (unlink/move/link race, exhaustion, real test a), 215 green; always-convert (drop the current===sent comparison) -> 2 red (both unchanged-revision), 218 green; always-send-label (revert fix 1) -> 4 red (both label-absent, --allow-missing stored-casing, real test b), 216 green. Suites: link, rename, link-quest-race. HARNESS-SHAPED CONCURRENT RACE, lore from this worktree source, lore unlink and quest remove-label spawned concurrently, fresh workspace per trial: quest 0.10.0 -> lore exit 0 in 10 of 10 (0 of 10 with the conversion fix alone); quest 0.11.0 via the orchestrator race.sh -> lore exit 0 in 10 of 10, label absent after every trial. GATES: bun test 3851 pass 0 fail 1 skip (pre-existing conditional skip, not the new file: it runs 2 pass alone on the same PATH); bun run lore check exit 0 (82 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings); bun run typecheck exit 0; bunx biome check on the 4 files clean. Versions: bun 1.3.14, quest 0.10.0 installed, quest 0.11.0 from orchestrator scratch binary. LINK PATH: guarded per orchestrator ruling (opum-agent 2026-09-27), withConflictRetry plus guardedEditTask, reason in a code comment; no record-why-safe option taken.
